document_title: DISTRICT ENVIRONMENTAL PLAN FOR RAMANAGARA DISTRICT
base_year: Data as on 31-03-2021 (F-Reg / KSPCB Regional Office Ramanagara); population from 2011 Census
extraction_method: pdftotext -layout on text-based PDF (machine-readable, not scanned). Cover/first page rendered empty; all data pages are selectable text.
extraction_caveats: PDF is text-based and extracted cleanly except the cover page which is image/empty.

This is the RAMANAGARA district DEP. It does NOT contain the V-Valley / Peenya / 144-industries / 250 KLD CETP example row cited in the task; that row belongs to the Bengaluru URBAN district DEP, not this document. Ramanagara DEP explicitly states 'There are no CETP's in the Ramanagara District.'

Sewage figures are internally inconsistent across the DEP's own tables: the at-a-glance summary lists 18.87 MLD then a sub-table totaling 27.4 MLD; the Domestic Sewage section gives 23.32 MLD for Class-II-and-above towns. All three are reproduced verbatim below.
STP installed-capacity figures also vary by table: TMC Magadi appears as 3.2 MLD in one place and 3.71 MLD in others; CMC Ramanagara as 7.5 / 7.56 MLD.
Industrial-wastewater 'number of industries' varies: 562 Nos (at-a-glance), 581 Nos (industrial section), generated quantity consistently 5.652 MLD.

No single district-wide URBAN solid-waste total is printed; urban total below is summed from the per-ULB table (40.16+36+24+14.5+15 = 129.66 TPD, Harohalli not yet quantified). Rural/GP total is stated as 162.9754 MT/day (theoretical at 200 g/head/day).
Treated/untreated sewage volumes are explicitly 'Not Estimated' in the DEP; untreated percentage 'not quantified'.

sewage.treatment_gap_notes: CMC-Ramanagara existing STP (7.5 MLD) NOT adequate for 10.12 MLD generated, plus missing UGD links bypass STP (40% gap in UGD coverage). CMC-Kanakapura STP adequate but missing links. TMC-Magadi STP adequate but missing links. CMC-Channapatna has 0 STP (UGD under construction, septic tanks/soak pits). Bidadi 0 STP. Harohalli 0 STP.

effluent.trade_effluent_treatment: Treated in existing in-premises ETPs; treated effluent fully recycled or used on-land for irrigation within premises per Consent conditions.
effluent.cetp_status: There are no CETPs in the Ramanagara District. No CETP proposed or sanctioned in this DEP.

solid_waste.rural_note: Actual GP quantity not available; theoretical at 200 g/head/day over population 814877.

processing.dry_waste_status: Materials segregated partially; remaining dumped in landfill site (per-ULB notes for Ramanagara, Channapatna, Kanakapura, Magadi; Bidadi to private land).

sanitary_landfill.note: CMC-Ramanagara & CMC-Channapatna dumpsites under litigation; Kanakapura & Magadi have functional SLF; Bidadi none.

legacy_dumpsite_waste_tonnes.note: DEP prints total as 5860 0 (layout split) = 58600 tonnes; sum of rows = 58600.

solid_waste.gap_notes: Source segregation: 115 of 139 urban wards at 100% segregation (gap 24 wards). 0 of 335 bulk waste generators have onsite composting. No district C&D recycling facility. Legacy dumpsite remediation DPRs mostly not started.
